metaDescription: Sign in securely with email or a passkey.
invalidLinkMessage: This sign-in link has expired or is invalid. Request a new link below.
title: Sign in
heroCopy: Sign in securely with email or a passkey — no password needed. That's how you keep homes, questions and deadlines in one place.
noAccountNote: You can also use WoonReality without an account. An account is only needed to save a dossier, documents and your personal progress.
magicLinkSent: We've sent a secure link to {email}. Open that link in this browser to continue.
magicLinkFailed: The sign-in link could not be sent. Please try again.
passkeysDisabledProject: Passkeys are not enabled yet in this project.
browserNoPasskeys: This browser doesn't support passkeys yet. Continue with email.
passkeySessionFailed: A session with your passkey could not be started.
passkeySignInFailed: Signing in with passkey isn't working right now. Try email.
signInUnavailable: Signing in is temporarily unavailable because the account system hasn't been set up yet.
continueWithoutAccount: You can keep using WoonReality without an account: search an address and view the reality check.
newHereHelper: New here? Your first email link confirms your address. Afterwards you can optionally add a passkey.
